# PreSecurity — TryHackMe Glossary

> **About this glossary:** Sample extract used for parser tests.

## Module 1 — Introduction to Cyber Security

| Term | Unit | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **`dirb`** | Introduction to Cybersecurity | A command-line web server scanner that brute-forces URLs with wordlists. |
| **`ls` / `ls -l` / `ls -al`** | Linux CLI Basics | Lists directory contents; `-l` shows details and `-a` includes hidden dotfiles. |
| **SIEM (Security Information and Event Management)** | Introduction to Cybersecurity | A centralized platform that aggregates logs and generates alerts. |
| **TTL (Time to Live)** | Packets & Frames | IP header hop counter decremented by 1 at each router. |

---

## Module 6 — How the Web Works

| Term | Unit | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **DMZ (Demilitarized Zone)** | Extending Your Network | Isolated perimeter subnet hosting public-facing servers. |
| **TTL (Time To Live — DNS)** | DNS in Detail | Duration in seconds specifying how long resolvers cache a DNS response. |
| **XSS (Cross-Site Scripting)** | How Websites Work | Injection vulnerability achieving arbitrary JavaScript execution. |
